timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,211.92 Cr (-1.3% YoY), net profit ₹1,492.62 Cr (+8.7% YoY).
LIC Housing Finance reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹1,497.41 Cr, up 9% YoY, and recommended a dividend of ₹10 per share.
LIC Housing Finance reported Q4 FY2026 standalone net profit of ₹1,497.41 Cr, up 9% YoY, and recommended a dividend of ₹10 per share.
LIC Housing Finance uploaded the audio recording and investor presentation for the Q4 FY26 earnings call held on May 14, 2026.
LIC Housing Finance uploaded the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings call held on May 14, 2026.
Life Insurance Corporation of India (S.K. Srivastava, Executive Director, Investment Office) declared no new encumbrances on LIC Housing Finance shares beyond those disclosed by March 31, 2026.
At its 37th AGM on 28 August 2026, LIC Housing Finance guided FY27 GNPA down to 1.9% from 2.15% and reiterated double-digit loan growth, with ROE targeted above 15-16%.
LIC Housing Finance Limited appointed Shri Sandeep Kumar (DIN: 11239285) as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer effective 23 October 2026.
